triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Feature · list cell editing redone after Attio: the row height stays when editing, form controls are no longer stuffed into cells, and each field type uses one of three patterns (type in place, open a popover, act directly); maintainer: 「我双击编辑的时候，点看右侧的界面很丑」 … 「立卡」; topic #35547 → p2 as set by the coordinator · size L (per field type; the claimant may split by pattern).

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: card thread · 2026-11-21T09:14Z · slice S3 of #35688 carries `Part of #36023`; this card is claimed with it. The full claim, scope and split are on #35688 (S3 claim posted the same minute).
Area: b1-I7
Session: `session_01L6bhgTJobxYSxskrNbCuHE` (the S3 card thread, building itself under the dev-thread rule)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-jpvrtv
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/` lookup / master-detail / user, currency, percent, number, rating, rich-text preview, and the in-cell look of the seven typed-input widgets (text, number, currency, percent, email, phone, url); `ui/packages/fields/src/FieldEditWidget.tsx`; `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (in-cell host keys, read-only cell types); `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` (overlay padding and width only); the i18n packs (a few new hint keys); the QA checklist and Task Desk text for #35794; tests; a changeset.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:thread`, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (expected; widening: widgets read the existing `inCell` host key, and a few i18n keys are added). The seat runs the declaration L2 at `TIER_DEFAULT` on the measured declarations.
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise: the card thread's gap table on main `c00be39b` (read-only code check; browser readings marked "to measure"). #36023 (filed 2026-11-21 07:49Z, given to this seat 07:59:12Z) asks for more than #35688's remaining plan, so the card is cut into S3, S4 and a third piece.
Basis: card #35688 (epic #35683); card #36023 (epic #35547); the maintainer's ruling 7057128455 (「下周」 = today + 7 days) stands.
Scope, the seat's reading:
1. S3 (this PR): #35688's remaining per-type rows (lookup, master-detail and user as a searchable list that commits on pick, with recent and clear, and the local recents key prefixed by the user id; currency as the currency code plus the raw number right-aligned; percent without the slider; rating set in place; formula, rollup, autonumber and attachment as read-only cells; #35794), plus from #36023 the flat in-cell input for the seven typed-input kinds (height = row height, no own border, radius or fill, numbers right-aligned, long content grows to the right) and the rating number keys 1 to 5.
2. Rich text: this PR shows the preview and a hint to edit on the record page, as #35688 says. The panel editor #36023 asks for is not refused; it stays on #36023 for a later slice.
3. Where #35688 and #36023 differ, the newer card #36023 is taken: the pop-up panel opens under the cell and leaves the cell value as it is; multi-select and tags save on Esc; Enter saves and stays on the cell. That last one reverses the merged #35687 behaviour (save and move down), so the PR that does it names the change in its body, does it in its own commit and updates the tests that assert the move.
4. S4 (new session, `Part of #36023`): panel under the cell for S1/S2's pop-up kinds, Esc saves for multi-select and tags, Enter stays, Backspace clears and saves (a required field refuses with a hint), validation keeps the input and shows the reason, the selection frame on frozen columns and the leftover orange frame after Esc.
5. The form's line-item table (`GridField`) is a separate component that S1 and S2 did not touch; the seat files it as its own card under #35547. The related-list tab follows #35892 and gets one reading after it lands.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. #36015 (thread building) edits `data-table.tsx` clicks and the email/phone renderers next to this slice; whoever lands second merges main. `overlap-check.mjs` runs before each push. The branch is the card thread's harness push branch, a measured platform exception to `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.

Claim: card thread · 2026-11-21T09:33Z · slice S5 of #36023, `Part of #36023`, running in parallel with S3 (claim 7060441741 on #35688) under the maintainer's 2026-11-21 09:26:27Z 「同意」 (independent slices of one big card open together). `Fixes #36023` goes on whichever of S4 or S5 lands last.
Area: b1-I8
Session: `session_01L6bhgXrmZgxib5C1kX7vnD` (the S5 card thread, building itself under the dev-thread rule)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-95eop8
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx` and its tests; `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/types.ts` (doc text: GridField becomes the second producer of the `inCell` / `onCommit` host keys); a changeset. No `packages/spec` change.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:thread`, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (expected; widening: GridField becomes the second producer of the existing `inCell` / `onCommit` host keys). The seat runs the declaration L2 at `TIER_DEFAULT`.
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise: the card thread's read on main `c00be39b` (`/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/36023/S5/premise.md`, code only, browser readings marked "to measure"). The form line-item table keeps every cell as an input; it is already flat and keeps its row height; what is missing is the pop-up kinds.
Basis: card #36023 (epic #35547).
Scope, the seat's reading (way A, recommended; the choice between A and select-then-edit B goes to the maintainer after a fable review, and this claim is amended if B is picked):
1. Keep direct typing. Select, date, datetime and time open the S2 in-cell panels under the cell on click, Enter or typing, and commit on pick; long text floats right while focused; Esc discards the cell's current change; the "date does not exist" line becomes a popover under the cell instead of a second line that grows the row.
2. Enter keeps its current line-item rule (move down; at the last row add a row), unless the maintainer rules otherwise.
3. Lookup takes S3's `LookupField` in-cell face once S3 merges; if S5 is ready first, lookup stays as it is and follows.
4. Not in this slice: new column types (check, rating, multi-select, tags, people, colour) need the spec column-type enum, so they go to their own card; people and multi-select folded into plain text boxes get a bug card if the browser reading confirms it.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: parallel slice; no fold. #36032 does not touch GridField (file list checked). S3/S4 may meet only on `LookupField`; `overlap-check.mjs` runs before each push and the second to land merges main. The branch is the card thread's harness push branch, a measured platform exception to `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.

Area: b1-I9

Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-ip84hj
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: `ui/packages/components/src/context/gridCellSelection.tsx`; `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/dataTableCellOverlay.tsx` (placement); `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` (edit block placement and commit gate, select-first Backspace/Delete, cell focus and outline classes, Enter only if ruled); `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (`describeCell` facts only); `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/InCellOptionList.tsx`, `MultiSelectField.tsx`, `TagsField.tsx`, `date-picker/DatePickerField.tsx`; the i18n packs (a few `table.*` keys); tests; a changeset.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:thread`, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (expected; widening: `GridCellFacts` gains optional `editor`, `clearRefusal` and `validate`, measured on `@object-ui/components` `dist/context/gridCellSelection.d.ts`; a few i18n keys). The seat runs the declaration L2 at `TIER_DEFAULT`.
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise: the card thread's read on main `c00be39b` (`/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/36023/S4/premise.md`, code only). The data table cannot tell a select from a text column, so the host says which cells open a panel below, through the per-cell selection facts `ObjectGrid.describeCell` already supplies.
Basis: card #36023 (epic #35547); a fable review of the open questions (09:30Z) and the maintainer's answers on the two decision cards in the seat thread.
Scope, the seat's reading:
1. Picker kinds (select, status, multi-select, tags, date, datetime, time, colour, and lookup/people from S3) open their panel under the cell and leave the cell value as drawn; the typeable date box moves into the panel top. Long text and address keep their in-place editor that does not jump.
2. Backspace or Delete on a selected cell clears and saves; a required field does not clear and shows a hint (`clearRefusal`).
3. A failing validation keeps the input and the editor open and shows the reason under the cell: the browser's own bad-input reading and an optional host `validate` (declared min/max, length, format). Esc discards.
4. The selection frame is not drawn over frozen columns; no orange frame is left after Esc.
5. Waiting the maintainer's decision cards, built last and only as ruled: Enter = save and stay (reverses merged #35687; own commit, named in the body, #35687's open Safari check text reworded) and Esc saving for multi-select and tags. Until ruled, Esc = discard for every kind and Enter is unchanged.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: parallel slice; no fold. S3 edits `data-table.tsx` overlay padding/width and `ObjectGrid.tsx` in-cell keys; #36033 (#36015) edits data-table clicks and keyboard. `overlap-check.mjs` runs before each push; the second to land merges main. The branch is the card thread's harness push branch, a measured platform exception to `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T09:40Z · D4 (multi-select and tags, Esc): the maintainer chose on the seat's decision card at 2026-11-21 09:40:13Z: **Esc discards; only a click outside saves.** This replaces the card's "Esc or a click outside closes and saves" for multi-select and tags. Esc = discard stays the same for every field kind, as agreed on #35687. Asked after a fable review of the open questions. S4 (claim 7060668598) builds no Esc-saves exception. D2 (Enter = save and stay) is still open on its own card.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T09:41Z · D2 (Enter while editing a cell in the main list): the maintainer chose on the seat's decision card at 2026-11-21 09:40:23Z: **Enter saves and stays on the cell.** This supersedes #35687's "Enter saves and moves down" for the main list; Arrow keys move down, Tab moves right. Asked after a fable review. S4 (claim 7060668598) builds it in its own commit, names the reversal of #35687 in the PR body, migrates the tests that assert the move, and rewords #35687's open Safari pinyin manual check ("a second Enter commits and moves down" becomes "a second Enter commits and stays"). It does not carry over to the form's line-item table (S5, claim 7060659968), where Enter keeps moving down and adds a row at the last row.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Seat note · 2026-11-21T11:39Z · Scope amendment for S4 (claim 7060668598, PR #36054), from the seat's declaration L2 record on S3 (PR #36045):
1. User cells: an avatar made the row 41px, dropping to 32 while the editor is open. This is #35688's first acceptance line (row height does not change while editing) and #36023's rule; S3 (which closes #35688) hands it to S4, and PR #36054 already carries the fix (avatar 24px, row stays 33 in rest, edit and after Esc; pin `userCell.rowHeight-36023.test.tsx`).
2. Required rating: Backspace, Delete or the 0 key on a required rating must refuse with the same hint as other required cells (`clearRefusal`), not write null. Added to S4's item 2.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Seat note · 2026-11-21T12:09Z · What #36023 still owes once its three slices land

S3 #36045 (`Part of #36023`) is armed, S5 #36039 is held on a bundle-budget question for the maintainer, and S4 #36054 now carries `Part of #36023` too: its declaration L2 (record 7062326255) found that `Fixes` would close this card with lines undelivered. The seat closes this card by hand when each line below is delivered, moved to its own card, or ruled out by the maintainer:

1. **Rich text** opens a panel under the cell. Today it shows a preview and a hint (S3 claim); the panel is a later slice on this card.
2. **The related-list tab** acceptance line waits on #35892.
3. **Multi-line text and address** still edit in place over the cell, not in a panel below it as this card's item 2 asks. That was a reviewed recommendation (keep the in-place full-text editor), not a maintainer ruling, so the seat is asking the maintainer now.
4. **#35687**: the seat rewords its body and its hold comments 7034313280 / 7036801771 to "Enter saves and stays" (ruling 7060745834) when S4 lands.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer rulings · 2026-11-21T13:13Z · #36023, two answers on the seat's decision cards (both reviewed by fable first)

1. **Multi-line text and address stay in place** (option A, 2026-11-21T13:12Z). Their editor keeps opening over the cell, with the full text and no jump in position or size. Item 2's "panel under the cell" applies to the picker kinds only, as S4 #36054 built it. Leftover 3 in the seat note 7062367434 is closed by this ruling.
2. **The eager `ui-components` budget is raised by about 8 KB, with headroom** (option B, 2026-11-21T13:12Z), so S5 #36039 (the form's line-item grid cells, +2,679 B gzip measured on one main) can land. The raise goes in its own budget-only PR, not on #36039. As `ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` "Raising it" requires, that PR moves the ceiling and the baseline together, publishes the rows from two builds on one tree, says what the bytes buy, and cites this ruling as the maintainer's authorisation. A separate card follows to take GridField out of the eager chunk (it is dynamically imported but also statically exported), after which the ceiling can come back down.

Still owed on this card: leftover 1 (rich text panel), leftover 2 (related-list tab, waits on #35892), and leftover 4 (the #35687 rewording at S4's landing).

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T14:09Z · #36023, the eager `ui-components` budget (amends point 2 of 7063116595)

At 2026-11-21T14:01Z, in the budget card thread, the maintainer widened the raise: 「这个可以大幅放宽」, and picked the option "raise 30%, to 451,100" on that thread's decision card. The ceiling becomes 347,000 × 1.30 = 451,100 bytes; the baseline goes back to the measured value, as the 11-17 30% and 20% rulings did.

How it lands: #36100 (+8,000) is already in the merge queue and lands as it is, so S5 #36039 is not held up. Then the budget thread opens one follow-up PR from the new main that changes only the ceiling and baseline to 451,100, with the rows from two builds on one tree as `ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` "Raising it" requires, and cites this ruling as the maintainer's authorisation. The GridField card #36102 stays open: taking GridField out of the eager chunk is still wanted, it is no longer what lets the budget come back down.
